extracted.intended_audience: readers of Nature (scientists, technical instrument buyers), advertisers, and job applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and procedural standards for submitting advertisements, editorial communications, subscriptions, and applications (academic/teaching posts) to the journal Nature, plus supplier quality/return policies described in notices and adverts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elimination of thiosulphate in photographic preservation
rubrics_metrics.description: The preservation of photographic positives and negatives obtained by means of silver salts depends upon the total elimination of the thiosulphate ("hypo") used for fixing them. Potassium permanganate is recommended as free from disadvantages of other oxidising agents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure suggested: after rinsing 2–3 times for about a minute with water, place positive or negative in a porcelain or glass dish; for half-plate size add 250 c.c. of dilute permanganate (made by diluting 10 c.c. of a solution containing 1 gram per litre). If the solution turns brownish, add more permanganate until a pink tint remains. Then place the print in a 1 per cent oxalic acid solution to remove any faint brown deposit. Wash with ordinary water until clear. Oxalic acid gives a precipitate with ordinary water, indicating when washing is completed. Warnings: other oxidising agents (perborates, persulphates) are expensive, may spoil positives/negatives if they act too long, and make it difficult to tell when oxidation is complete; potassium permanganate avoids these disadvantages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing and routing of correspondence to Nature
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices: Advertisements and business letters for Nature should be addressed to the Publishers; editorial communications to the Editor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The telegraphic address of Nature is given as "Phusis," London. Ensure correspondence is routed correctly according to type (advertising/business vs editorial).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising formatting and charging rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Charges for advertisements are specified by line/column/size; the first line in heavy type is charged as two lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples given (formats and prices printed alongside notices): 'Three lines in Column' and 'Per Line after' price rules; page-size prices (sixteenth, eighth, quarter, whole pages) are listed. Cheques and Money Orders should be payable to MACMILLAN & CO., limited. When planning an advert, account for heavy-type first-line surcharges and published per-line and page rates; consult the office for exact current rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and copy request procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies of Nature can be obtained through any bookseller or post-free from the Publishers on payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific small payments (e.g., 3d for residents in British Isles, 4d from abroad for a single copy) are required when requesting post-free copies from the Publishers; check current amounts and postal conditions when requesting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application form and testimonial requirements for London County Council appointments
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications for teaching/assistant posts must be made on the official form obtainable from the Clerk of the London County Council Education Offices and must be returned by the stated deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be accompanied by particulars of the appointment and copies of three testimonials of recent date. Candidates applying by post should enclose a stamped and addressed envelope for the form. Canvassing, directly or indirectly, will be held to be a disqualification for employment. Follow the precise deadline and submission instructions printed in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualification and submission requirements for University College of North Wales (assistant lecturer)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are invited for the post of Assistant Lecturer in the Day Training Department; candidates should have special qualifications in Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications and testimonials should be submitted by the stated closing date (example given: not later than Saturday, June 8). Contact details for further particulars are provided (name of secretary/registrar). Ensure required qualifications and deadlines are met and that testimonials are recent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mineral specimen 'approval' consignments and quality guarantee
rubrics_metrics.description: The mineral supplier will send specimens on approval (at their expense) with the privilege of selection; consignee may return undesired material at the supplier's expense. Printed labels with each specimen give correct name, chemical composition, and locality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The supplier takes the risk of loss or breakage and bears the cost of double transport for approval consignments; they will promptly refund money if the selection does not meet expectations. Institutions may pay after delivery subject to regulations. Buyers are encouraged to give preferred size, average price, and character of specimens to assist selection. A printed catalogue is available on application.
